description: This file defines the ADODB_XML class, which provides methods for manipulating XML files related to databases, including converting database tables to XML and inserting XML data into database tables. It relies on external classes such as XMLFile and ADOdb database library.

classes.name: ADODB_XML
classes.description: A PHP class for converting database tables to XML files and inserting XML data into database tables, with configurable root and row tags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ADODB_XML object with optional XML version, encoding, and temporary directory.

methods.name: ConvertToXMLString
methods.description: Converts a database query result to an XML string.

methods.name: ConvertToXML
methods.description: Converts a database query result to an XML file.

methods.name: InsertIntoDB
methods.description: Reads XML data from a file and inserts it into a specified database table.

methods.name: setRootTagName
methods.description: Sets the name of the root XML tag.

methods.name: setRowTagName
methods.description: Sets the name of the row XML tag.

methods.name: getRootTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of the root XML tag.

methods.name: getRowTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of the row XML tag.
